source.title: Bottom-Up Copper Filling of Millimeter Size Through Silicon Vias

tag: [FT] full text (PMC, OA CC BY-NC-ND) read 2026-10-28

conditions.bath: 1 mol/L CuSO4 + 0.5 mol/L H2SO4 + Tetronic 701 + NaCl (low Cl: 80 umol/L Cl + 40 umol/L TET; high Cl: 1 mmol/L Cl + 25-50 umol/L TET)
conditions.hydrodynamics: helicopter rotation 400 rpm (~40 cm/s at ~1 cm radius); prewet EtOH/IPA vacuum; 2 min -0.40 V mix step
conditions.vias: 125 um dia x ~625 um deep (mm-TSV), ALD Pt seed including re-entrant notch

series.morphology: deposition localized at via bottom; sidewall passive-active transition; concave front
upward filling progressed but does not reach mouth

data.note: their Fig 2 shows multiple times at -0.51 V; individual heights not in text - digitise Fig 2 for h(t) (est. error +-20 um)

protocols.outcome: higher sidewall deposit than 6 h at -0.51
fill indistinguishable from 12.5 h run; halts just below mouth at final -0.56 V

series.tag: [FT] fig 6 shows several times; growth front convex, max at via middle, cusps at sidewalls, asymmetry from flow

data.note: digitise their Fig 6 for h(t) (est. error +-20 um)

points.outcome: active deposition stops before mouth; 12 h still below mouth

points.protocol: 4 h at -0.62, 2 s at -0.8 (re-activation), then 2 h at -0.64
points.outcome: transition moved up; bottom of voided region marks 4 h front

points.protocol: 4 h at -0.62 @400 rpm then 1.5 h at -0.64 @200 rpm
points.outcome: deposit exits via mouth (rpm reduction helps final fill)
NO bottom-up initiation: metal-ion transport insufficient

notes: The 12.5 h protocol (5x1.5 h -0.51..-0.55 + 5 h -0.56, low Cl) is the published VOID-FREE recipe for 125x625 um mm-TSV at 400 rpm, ~295 K. Critical negative result for our sim: rotation below ~200 rpm kills bottom-up in 1 mmol/L Cl baths (metal transport starvation) - supports 'never stir zero, fix rpm' rule. Fill fronts at fixed -0.51 V (low Cl) and -0.60 V (high Cl) are the two h(t) series to digitise for model validation.
